reason: I already keep my spending in a Google Sheet and my bank app shows my transaction history, so I don't see what this adds for me. The slip and statement features sound useful, but I'd still have to set up an iPhone Shortcut and trust a new app with my financial data just to save a bit of typing.
objection: My bank app already shows my history, so why would I move my money tracking somewhere else and trust a new app with my data?
would_change_my_mind: If it could pull my slips and card statements into my own spreadsheet automatically with no setup, and I could export everything, I would reconsider.
